title: Thirdway carousel
description: A horizontal scroll-snap track with two round outlined arrow buttons (the prev one dims at the start, the next at the end). The controls sit under the track on phones and above it, next to a label, from tablet up.
notes: place it full width: the track pads its own sides with the page gutter and bleeds to the right edge
buttons need JavaScript; the track itself scrolls and snaps without it
